title: Bijection
summary: A bijection pairs two collections without omission or collision.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared functions context is fixed.

content.plain: A bijection pairs two collections without omission or collision.
content.exact: f:X→Y is bijective iff it is injective and surjective; equivalently, it has a two-sided inverse.
content.example: n↦n+1 is a bijection from ℤ to ℤ.
content.caveat: Bijection captures one notion of equal cardinality, not every notion of structural equivalence.
